body: **TSKB Co-Venture** is an end-to-end venture building program powered by Türkiye Sınai Kalkınma Bankası **(TSKB)** and Türkiye Girişimcilik Vakfı **(GİRVAK)**. It guides technology-based startups from the ideation stage to product-market fit, scaling, and investment readiness.

Across a **_12-month tailored journey_**, startups gain hands-on strategic guidance, expert mentorship, corporate network access, and investor connections. Special priority is given to teams with **_female co-founders/executives_** and entrepreneurs impacted by the February 6 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes.

stats.label: month journey
stats.text: One tailored track per startup — from ideation to investment readiness.

stats.label: focus areas
stats.text: Climate, education, disaster resilience and health technologies.

stats.label: women founders
stats.text: Women-led teams and founders from earthquake-affected regions are prioritised.

stats.label: with TSKB
stats.text: An eight-year partnership, not a campaign — Co-Venture is its next chapter.

for_who: Tech-based, scalable startups working in disaster, health, education and climate
Early-stage teams validating business models and developing MVPs
Growth-stage startups ready to scale, access corporate networks and secure investment
what_happens: Modular trainings and hands on workshops
1-on-1 mentorship with industry experts and corporate partners
Product-market validation, go-to-market strategy and scaling support
Corporate pilots, investor showcases and dedicated venture funds upon Demo Day
